label: Update gate rises at D2 after a2->S1 rare transitions, and at GO after losses when S2 seems good.
short_terms: (phase == D2) * (prev_action + action - prev_state - state) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * (1 - belief) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * ep_dec
terms: (phase == D2) * (prev_action - prev_state) ;; (phase == D2) * (action - state) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("reward", -2) == 0) * (tv("reward", -3) == 0) * ep_dec ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * (1 - belief) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * (prev_action == 2) * ep_dec
explanation: Raw z of unit 36 is almost entirely timing (near 0 at D1/GO, ~0.85-0.95 at D2, rising late in the episode); residuals are small. At D2 it is higher when this trial or the previous trial had a rare a2->S1 transition and lower after rare a1->S2 transitions (signed action minus state, this and previous trial; strongest dip after a1 S2 unrewarded). At GO it rises after an unrewarded previous trial, more so when the observer believes S2 is good (low belief), and more late in the episode; the large GO spikes (0.2-0.5) occur on runs of consecutive losses late in episodes before a2 choices and are only partly captured. D1 carries almost nothing. The free fit adds consecutive-loss counts and prev a2 loss terms (dev 0.40 vs short 0.36). All terms observed-only (action/state at D2 are already seen).
